text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 31 vials of gentamicin sulfate 40 mg/mL, 2 mL injection with 2 days on hand at 15.3 vials per day. Corvale General holds 244 vials of the same presentation with 15 days on hand at 16.3 vials per day. Corvale Lakeside holds 35 vials with 7.7 days on hand. Other presentations and strengths have adequate supply across sites.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show gentamicin sulfate is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; an earlier shortage was first posted 2021-07-23 and is resolved. The earlier shortage posting on 2021-07-23 followed a VAI inspection at Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1021343) that ended 2019-11-21, 610 days before the posting. A later VAI inspection at Cosette Pharmaceuticals NC Laboratories, LLC (FEI 1053439) ended 2023-07-21, 728 days after the 2021-07-23 posting.

Our position: No national shortage exists. The risk is local to Corvale East for the 40 mg/mL, 2 mL vial. Internal redistribution and commercial purchase can resolve the gap without clinical changes.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 16 vials of 40 mg/mL, 2 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Purchase additional 40 mg/mL, 2 mL vials from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — approved by buyer.
3. Purchase additional 40 mg/mL, 2 mL vials from Baxter Healthcare Corporation — approved by buyer.
4. Purchase additional 40 mg/mL, 2 mL vials from Eugia US LLC — approved by buyer.
5. Substitute Hospira, Inc. 40 mg/mL, 2 mL vial via alternate NDC — approved by pharmacist (already approved by Sam Rivera, MD on 2026-04-12).

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or alternative agent selections; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
